policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Asgrimur Vidisson has made thirty-eight saves for Maryville and conceded nine, a save percentage of .809.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-eight goals exceed what the four lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them, but the bar has not moved since Maryville's afternoon against them: they were held scoreless by Missouri S&T on Wednesday while Maryville scored again at Upper Iowa.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Two matches past their date carry no published result, and both are Drury's: at home to Evangel and away at Wash U.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Lincoln remain the only programme in the conference yet to lose: four wins and three draws, thirteen goals scored and six conceded, the fourth win coming at Rockhurst on Wednesday.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Missouri S&T have not drawn a match this season: six wins and two defeats, nineteen goals scored and nine conceded.
